project.name: AxonFlow Java SDK — AuthZEN Example
project.description:
The AuthZEN-native authorization surface (ADR-065) against a running AxonFlow agent: nine steps, four of them refusals.
NOTE ON THE VERSION BELOW. It matches the SDK's current pom version, and that coordinate is already on Maven Central WITHOUT the authzen package - this work sits under [Unreleased]. So `mvn -DskipTests install` on the SDK first is not a convenience, it is required, and it OVERWRITES the cached Central artifact for that coordinate in your local ~/.m2. That is the pattern every example in this repository already follows; correcting it means giving the examples a snapshot coordinate, which is a change to the release process rather than to this example.
